SHIFTER VPN · IMPLEMENTATION REVIEW

One account. Every workspace.

The VPN follows the Proxy Extension’s workspace contract: one account API key, every accessible team, and credentials and usage tied to the selected membership.

62 tests passed9 viewport sizes + enlarged textFlutter analyzer cleanmacOS debug build passed

Responsive preview

Implemented behavior

  • Memberships and proxy-config request ?workspaces=all. Usage stays unfiltered. User API requests send both Bearer and X-Api-Key headers using the existing account key, kept in OS secure storage.
  • Workspace metadata joins by plan hash, with proxy-config fallback, Personal first, alphabetically sorted teams, and empty workspaces retained.
  • Phone sheets and wider plan lists share the same grouping. Personal-only and legacy responses retain an ungrouped list. Product names remain unchanged.
  • Team names and plan/wallet attribution appear on the connection screen. All four roles can connect. Viewer and billing management links say “Open in panel”.
  • Switching plans disconnects the previous tunnel. Targets stay specific to each membership. Credentials refresh before connection. A catalog refresh that finds revoked access clears the stored selection and stops its active tunnel.
  • Late catalog responses cannot restore signed-out workspace data. Sign-out clears workspaces.

Verification

Local HTTP API and authenticated proxy fixtures exercised all roles, Residential and ISP credentials, usage, switching, restored selections, removed access, empty workspaces, legacy responses and stale requests. Widget tests covered 280×653, 320×568, 393×852, 600×800, 768×1024, 1024×768, 1440×900, 1024×480 and 844×390, plus 1.3× text at 320px.

flutter analyze
flutter test test/api_and_connect_test.dart test/proxy_test.dart test/workspaces_test.dart test/workspace_layout_test.dart --dart-define=WORKSPACE_SCREENSHOTS=true
flutter build macos --debug

Production workspaces were not tested with a live team account. The extension’s API notes identify backend deployment as a prerequisite; deployment status was not verified. Android/iOS device builds were not performed for this change.

Download the local macOS debug build. This is a development build, not a notarized distribution release.
